fields.Name: IT93 - Prompt Eval Harness
fields.Description: Verifies the prompt-eval measuring instrument itself, deterministically and without a single model token: every corpus case names an agent and capabilities that exist in the catalog (PE1); the generated MJ: Tests records have not drifted from the golden files (PE2); every expectation is decidable — a synthesized correct answer passes it (PE3); a scripted correct reply scores correct through the REAL AIPromptRunner with TestLLM registered over the driver classes (PE4); five distinct malformed shapes are actually caught, including the undispatchable step types MJ's own exemplars taught before the exemplar audit (PE5); and a wrong-but-well-formed reply separates decision accuracy from malformed rate so a comparison can attribute a delta to one or the other (PE6). PE5 is the load-bearing negative: a harness that cannot fail on demand makes every rate it reports a fiction. 6 checks, read-only, server transport.
